title: THE MACHINE
message: A system can change you without explaining what it does.
meaning:
The Machine is transformation without a visible material cause.

Its components are precise, interconnected and apparently functional, yet the center contains nothing that can be identified as the thing being processed.

Something enters one state and emerges in another.

Understanding every mechanism may still not explain the transformation itself.
imageAlt: An intricate vertical machine surrounding a dark unidentified center
